title: Corollary
body_md:
Let $F$ be monotone and $1$-symmetric $(L_0,L_1)$-Lipschitz.
Run Algorithm~\ref{alg:AdaptiveAlgo} with positive
initial estimates, $\rho>2$, and $\nu>0$ satisfying
$\nu e^\nu<1$ for {\color{PineGreen}\sfEG-LS}\xspace or
$\nu e^\nu< \frac12$ for {\color{PineGreen}\sfPEG-LS}\xspace. Then if 
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
    \item $F$ is \textbf{monotone}: the stepsize-weighted average $\bar{x}_K$
satisfies: 
$$\texttt{Gap}_{F,B}\left( \bar{x}_K\right)=\mathcal{O}\left(K^{-1}\right),$$ 
under the same conditions as 
Theorem~\ref{thm: EG monotone}
and Theorem~\ref{thm: popov monotone}.
\item $F$ is \textbf{strongly monotone}: the iterates $x_k$ have linear convergence in $\|x_k-x^*\|^2$ for {\color{PineGreen}\sfEG-LS}\xspace and in $R_k= \|x_k-x^*\|^2+\|x_k-\hat{x}_{k-1}\|^2$ for {\color{PineGreen}\sfPEG-LS}\xspace.
\end{itemize} 
The explicit bounds are given in
Appendix~\ref{app: backtrack proofs}.

title: Proof
body_md:
Let $\Gamma_K=\sum_{k=0}^{K-1} \gamma_k \geq K\underline{\gamma}$. We have
\begin{align*}
    \sup_{y\in B} \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} \gamma_k \left\langle F(y),z_k - y\right\rangle &=  \Gamma_K\sup_{y\in B} \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} \left\langle F(y),\frac{z_k\gamma_k}{\Gamma_K} - \frac{\gamma_ky}{\Gamma_K}\right\rangle \\
    &= \Gamma_K\sup_{y\in B}  \left\langle F(y),\sum_{k=0}^{K-1}\left( \frac{z_k\gamma_k}{\Gamma_K} - \frac{\gamma_ky}{\Gamma_K} \right)\right\rangle\\
    &= \Gamma_K\sup_{y\in B}  \left\langle F(y),\sum_{k=0}^{K-1}\left( \frac{z_k\gamma_k}{\Gamma_K} \right) -y\right\rangle \\
    &=\Gamma_K\texttt{Gap}_{F,B}\left( \bar{z}_K\right) \\
    &\geq K\underline{\gamma} \texttt{Gap}_{F,B}\left( \bar{z}_K\right)
\end{align*}
where for the last step $\bar{z}_K\in B$ ensures that $\texttt{Gap}_{F,B}\left( \bar{z}_K\right)$ is nonnegative.

body_md:
Let $F(\tilde{x}_k)$ denote $F(x_k)$ for  
  \begingroup
  \hypersetup{linkcolor=PineGreen} 
  \hyperref[EG_update]{\color{PineGreen}\sfEG} 
  \endgroup
  \xspace
 method and $F(\hat{x}_{k-1})$ for  
  \begingroup
  \hypersetup{linkcolor=PineGreen} 
  \hyperref[PEG_update]{\color{PineGreen}\sfPEG} 
  \endgroup
  \xspace
 method. Then we have the following:
    \begin{align}
        \|x_{k+1}-y\|^2 &= \|P_U(x_k-\gamma_k F(\hat{x}_k)) - y\|^2 \notag\\
        &\overset{(\ref{proj norm diff})}{\leq} \|x_k - \gamma_kF(\hat{x}_k)-y\|^2 - \|x_k-\gamma_kF(\hat{x}_k)-x_{k+1}\|^2 \notag\\
        &= \|x_k-y\|^2 - \|x_{k+1}-x_k\|^2-2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\hat{x}_k),x_{k+1}-y\right\rangle \notag\\
        &= \|x_k-y\|^2 - \|x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k+\hat{x}_k -x_k\|^2-2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\hat{x}_k),x_{k+1}-y\right\rangle \notag\\
        &= \|x_k-y\|^2 - \|x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k\|^2-\|\hat{x}_k -x_k\|^2 \notag\\
        &\qquad- 2\left\langle x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k,\hat{x}_k -x_k\right\rangle-2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\hat{x}_k),x_{k+1}-y\right\rangle \notag\\
        &= \|x_k-y\|^2 - \|x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k\|^2 - \|\hat{x}_k -x_k\|^2  \notag\\
        &\qquad- 2\left\langle x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k,\hat{x}_k -(x_k-\gamma_k F(\tilde{x}_k))\right\rangle \notag\\
        &\qquad+2\gamma_k\left\langle x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k,F(\tilde{x}_k)\right\rangle-2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\hat{x}_k),x_{k+1}-y\right\rangle \notag\\
        &\overset{(\ref{proj inprd})}{\leq} \|x_k-y\|^2 - \|x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k\|^2-\|\hat{x}_k -x_k\|^2  \notag\\
        &\qquad + 2\gamma_k\left\langle x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k,F(\tilde{x}_k)\right\rangle-2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\hat{x}_k),x_{k+1}-y\right\rangle  \notag\\
        &= \|x_k-y\|^2 - \|x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k\|^2-\|\hat{x}_k -x_k\|^2 \notag\\
        &\qquad + 2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\tilde{x}_k)-F(\hat{x}_k),x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k\right\rangle - 2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\hat{x}_k),\hat{x}_k - y\right\rangle \notag\\
        &\overset{(\ref{cauchy-schwarz})}{\leq} \|x_k-y\|^2 - \|x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k\|^2-\|\hat{x}_k -x_k\|^2 \notag\\
        &\qquad + 2\gamma_k\|F(\hat{x}_k)-F(\tilde{x}_k)\|\|x_{k+1}-\hat{x}_k\| - 2\gamma_k\left\langle F(\hat{x}_k),\hat{x}_k - y\right\rangle \notag
    \end{align}
    as desired.
